title: Causally available SLOOS C&I credit-supply tightening impulse and US30-versus-US100 book state
central_question: Does a causally available quarterly increase in domestic banks' net tightening of C&I credit standards for large and middle-market firms make the existing US30 book materially worse than the existing US100 book in stressed lifecycle value and stop quality?

frontier_selection.selection_reason: Program 2 alone now has an exact authoritative previsible input, a fixed treatment/comparator, both terminal decisions and a distinct economic mechanism. Recent Program 1 concentration and the completed Program 5 Unit 062 weigh against remaining in either neighborhood.

program_assessment.1: Units 093 and 094 consume the currently ready independent entry and market-structure roles; lattice, threshold, window, direction, symbol and subgroup follow-ups are adjacent rescues.
program_assessment.2: Federal Reserve SLOOS C&I lending-standard changes provide a newly ready bank-credit-supply role. The exact release vintage and one field can be frozen before portfolio outcomes, and the state can be used only after its official release date.
program_assessment.3: No synchronized causal bid-ask recovery or independent timing treatment is available at native decisions; activity-clock variants remain adjacent to closed timing work.
program_assessment.4: No new previsible held-position checkpoint has both required input and an allowed exit decision; current ideas reopen closed signal-state, adverse-path or stop families.
program_assessment.5: Unit 062 closes the stop/lot question at reference capital; remaining proposals lack an authoritative synchronized counterfactual or reopen allocation, admission, sizing or cap closures.
program_assessment.7: Meta audits are selected, non-comparable or already settled by governing policy and cannot change an economic decision.

unit_092_h41_reserve_balance.distance: Unit 092 used weekly H.4.1 reserve-balance expand/contract observations as a monetary-balance-sheet state. Unit 095 uses a quarterly bank survey's change in the extensive-margin policy for approving large and middle-market C&I credit. It uses no H.4.1 field, magnitude, release, threshold, lag or rescue.

unit_089_cftc_flow.distance: Positioning flow and bank lending policy are different source owners, mechanisms, schedules and state variables.

unit_091_cash_breadth.distance: Prior cash-market breadth is a price-derived daily market state; SLOOS is an independently published bank-credit-supply policy change.

distance_from_closed_work.selection_not_adjacency: Unit 095 is selected only after Unit 092 closed, Units 093 and 094 closed, the no-ready-candidate observation boundary was recorded, Unit 062 was corrected and fully closed, and Programs 1-5 and 7 were compared again.

mechanism_prior_only.official_owner: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System
mechanism_prior_only.role: Rationale only; these pages do not provide treatment values or portfolio outcomes and cannot change a gate.

sources.use: Lending-standard changes as a credit-supply indicator with macroeconomic transmission.
C&I loan-supply tightening as a distinct bank-credit mechanism; causal limitations remain explicit.

mechanism_prior_only.limitation: The observational survey impulse may remain endogenous to macroeconomic expectations; this experiment can retain only one later risk-tilt question, never identify a deployable causal policy by itself.

predeclaration_outcome_free_feasibility.official_archive_checked: The official SLOOS archive visibly contains January, April, July and October releases for 2022-2025 and January, April and July for 2026, totaling 19 required source vintages from 2022-01 through 2026-07.
predeclaration_outcome_free_feasibility.schema_checked: Official April 2022 and July 2026 Table 1 pages visibly preserve Question 1A, domestic All Respondents, the five fixed response categories and percent columns.
not_checked_before_declaration: The complete 19-row SLOOS values or impulse-state counts
Any SLOOS-conditioned lifecycle final value, planned risk, stressed R or stop reason
Any book, period, component, magnitude, concentration, gate or verdict conditional on the SLOOS state
predeclaration_outcome_free_feasibility.density_policy: Treatment density is resolved only after the declaration is pushed. Failure of the frozen density gate closes Unit 095 invalid without widening a window, changing the threshold or substituting another SLOOS field.

official_source_contract.owner: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System
official_source_contract.selected_question: Question 1A: Standards for large and middle-market firms with annual sales of $50 million or more
official_source_contract.release_date_field: The Last Update date on the matching official release summary page; status month is not treated as the publication date.
official_source_contract.source_integrity: Persist byte-exact responses, response URL, byte count and SHA-256. Each release page and Table 1 page must match one declared release id and one status month.

frozen_credit_supply_state.first_release: 202201 is an anchor with no state because it has no in-bundle predecessor.
frozen_credit_supply_state.impulse: For every release from 202204 through 202607, IMPULSE_t = NET_t - NET_(t-1) in percentage points.
frozen_credit_supply_state.zero_policy: Exact zero belongs to the comparator and is never dropped or retuned.
frozen_credit_supply_state.causal_activation: A release state may label only a portfolio server date strictly later than its official Last Update date.
frozen_credit_supply_state.release_day: All lifecycle births on the official Last Update calendar date are excluded from conditional aggregation rather than assigned either the old or new state.
frozen_credit_supply_state.state_lookup: For every other lifecycle birth, use the latest official release with Last Update date strictly earlier than the birth server date and with a defined impulse.
frozen_credit_supply_state.state_duration: The selected state remains active until the next official release date, whose calendar day is again excluded.
frozen_credit_supply_state.timezone_policy: The strict next-server-date rule removes intraday and DST discretion; no timestamp conversion or same-day response window is estimated.
frozen_credit_supply_state.revision_policy: Use each archived release page and matching Table 1 page, never a current revised aggregate series.

frozen_lifecycle_reconstruction.ordering: Within each frozen period, concatenate pinned event files and preserve stable source-file and source-row order for equal server timestamps.
frozen_lifecycle_reconstruction.birth: OPEN for RC16, RC4, Cross, Pressure and Return; PASSIVE_FILL for Passive.
frozen_lifecycle_reconstruction.final: Pair the next same-component CLOSE or EXTERNAL_CLOSE by strict alternation, with no cross-component or cross-period match.
frozen_lifecycle_reconstruction.planned_risk: Positive planned_risk parsed from the final detail contract.
frozen_lifecycle_reconstruction.stop: One for DEAL_REASON_SL and zero for DEAL_REASON_EXPERT.
frozen_lifecycle_reconstruction.release_day_exclusion: Exclude a lifecycle only when its birth server date equals an official release date.
frozen_lifecycle_reconstruction.centering: Within each of the 24 component-period cells, subtract the all-state mean stressed_r and all-state mean stop indicator from every included lifecycle before state and book aggregation.

fixed_primary_metrics.book_r_effect: For each book, mean centered stressed_r in TIGHTENING_IMPULSE minus NON_TIGHTENING_IMPULSE.
fixed_primary_metrics.book_stop_effect: For each book, mean centered stop in TIGHTENING_IMPULSE minus NON_TIGHTENING_IMPULSE.
fixed_primary_metrics.relative_r_did: US30 book_r_effect minus US100 book_r_effect; negative means tightening is more adverse to US30.
fixed_primary_metrics.relative_stop_did: US30 book_stop_effect minus US100 book_stop_effect; positive means tightening worsens US30 stop quality relative to US100.
fixed_primary_metrics.period_metrics: Repeat both book effects and both differences-in-differences in every frozen period having both states in both books.
fixed_primary_metrics.component_metrics: Report each component's tightening-minus-non-tightening centered R and stop effects; no component may be dropped.
fixed_primary_metrics.period_concentration: For R and stop separately, compute each valid period's signed contribution to the pooled relative numerator and divide its absolute value by the sum of absolute period contributions.
fixed_primary_metrics.component_concentration: For R and stop separately, compute each component's signed contribution to its book-adjusted pooled relative numerator and divide its absolute value by the sum of absolute component contributions.

requirements: Every declared project and closed-boundary byte/hash pin passes.
Exactly 39 official HTML source files are frozen: one archive, 19 release summaries and 19 matching Table 1 pages.
All 19 declared release ids are unique and present, their status months match, and their Last Update dates are finite, unique and strictly increasing in release-id order.
Every Table 1 source contains exactly one Question 1A domestic All Respondents block with the five selected response percentages and a positive total-bank count.
Each five-category percentage sum is within 0.2 percentage point of 100, allowing only displayed one-decimal rounding.
The normalized file contains 19 rows, one anchor and exactly 18 finite impulses from 202204 through 202607.

Lifecycle reconstruction yields exactly 2,233 pairs, 2,027 CLOSE and 206 EXTERNAL_CLOSE finals, the six inherited component counts and pooled stressed net 407.04770000000565 within 1e-9 before release-day exclusion.
Exactly 1,051 normal days and 2,429 native signals reconstruct from the pinned event ledgers without duplicate or unmatched event.
Every non-release-day lifecycle birth maps to exactly one causally prior defined impulse state.
TIGHTENING_IMPULSE and NON_TIGHTENING_IMPULSE each contain at least six distinct release regimes that overlap the CP2 horizon.
Each state appears in at least three of the four frozen periods.
Each state has at least 120 included normal days across the full horizon.
Each pooled book-state cell has at least 150 included lifecycles.
At least three periods have both states in both books, and every period-book-state cell used for a period metric has at least 20 lifecycles.
Every pooled component-state cell has at least 20 included lifecycles.
All centered residual identities and period/component contribution identities hold within 1e-9.

fixed_directional_pass_gate.name: SLOOS tightening impulse is materially adverse to US30 relative to US100
requirements: Pooled relative_r_did is at most -0.10R.
Pooled relative_stop_did is at least +0.05.
US30 book_r_effect is negative and US30 book_stop_effect is positive.
US100 book_r_effect is nonnegative and US100 book_stop_effect is nonpositive.
Relative R is negative and relative stop is positive in at least three of the four frozen periods; if only three periods pass density, all three must align.
At least three of four US30 components have negative R and positive stop effects.
Both US100 components have nonnegative R and nonpositive stop effects.
No period contributes more than 60 percent of the absolute pooled relative-R numerator or the absolute pooled relative-stop numerator.
No component contributes more than 45 percent of the absolute pooled relative-R numerator or the absolute pooled relative-stop numerator.
Absolute pooled relative_r_did is below 0.05R.
Absolute pooled relative_stop_did is below 0.025.
No more than two frozen periods have both the predicted negative relative-R sign and positive relative-stop sign.
The joint component breadth of at least three adverse US30 components and both non-adverse US100 components is absent.

fixed_verdict_rules.pass: PASS_SLOOS_CI_TIGHTENING_IMPULSE_US30_RELATIVE_ADVERSE_RETAIN_ONE_BOOK_RISK_QUESTION when integrity, density and every directional pass requirement hold.
fixed_verdict_rules.no_field: NO_MATERIAL_SLOOS_CI_CREDIT_SUPPLY_BOOK_FIELD when integrity and density hold and the complete strong-null rule holds.
fixed_verdict_rules.ambiguous: AMBIGUOUS_SLOOS_CI_CREDIT_SUPPLY_BOOK_STATE_NO_CANDIDATE when integrity and density hold and neither preceding verdict applies.
fixed_verdict_rules.invalid: INVALID_SLOOS_CI_IMPULSE_OR_BOOK_RECONSTRUCTION_NO_VERDICT when any required official-source, project-input, reconstruction, causal mapping or density condition fails.
fixed_verdict_rules.opposite_direction: A large opposite-direction result is reported but cannot select a candidate because no opposite-direction treatment was declared; it closes ambiguous without a rescue.

decision_translation.pass: Preserve every current portfolio behavior and retain exactly one unopened later question: whether a marginal previsible US30-to-US100 risk tilt under the same SLOOS tightening impulse can improve whole-portfolio economics. It receives no implementation, candidate, parameter or promotion authority and must await a fresh whole-map comparison.
decision_translation.no_field: Preserve unconditional US30 and US100 book treatment and close the complete SLOOS credit-supply axis.
decision_translation.ambiguous: Preserve unconditional US30 and US100 book treatment, retain no candidate or seed, and close the complete SLOOS credit-supply axis.
decision_translation.invalid: Preserve unconditional treatment, retain no candidate or seed, and close Unit 095 without source substitution, window widening, threshold change or adjacent field repair.

after_declaration_push: Acquire and byte-pin the one complete official 39-HTML source bundle.
Parse and freeze one 19-row normalized source table plus one acquisition receipt before opening CP2 economic outcomes.
If source and density integrity pass, execute one fixed aggregation over all pinned CP2 ledgers and freeze derived rows, result and closure together.
Commit and push the closed experiment, then recompare Programs 1-5 and 7 before any successor.

stop_rules: A source, parsing, causal-date, reconstruction or density failure closes Unit 095 invalid; do not widen, replace or rescue the bundle.
After one successful exact official-source freeze, do not selectively reacquire a favorable release or field.
After one successful fixed economic aggregation, do not rerun metrics, change a threshold, relabel a state or reinterpret a gate.
A pass retains at most the single declared later marginal book-risk question and opens nothing automatically.
Every non-pass closes the SLOOS credit-supply family with no level, demand, terms, subgroup, lag, window, threshold, symbol, component or risk follow-up.
Implementation corrections do not become research units and have no arbitrary numeric count cap while the economic contract and consumed valid evidence remain unchanged.
